domain_compliance.notes: Entidades verificadas: Order (aggregate root con order_id, customer_id, items, status, shipping_address, billing_address), OrderItem (product_id, product_name, quantity, unit_price), Address (value object: street, city, state, zip_code, country), Money (value object: amount, currency), OrderStatus (PENDING, PAID, SHIPPED, CANCELLED). Invariantes presentes: mínimo un ítem por orden, mínimo 10.00 USD para PAID, transiciones de estado correctas, validaciones en OrderItem y Money.
